verdict.rationale: Glama documents that any registry server deployed to Glama gets an automatic Gateway endpoint through which agent calls are logged and access-controlled, and every server page ships pre-filled connection config for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and VS Code, making it straightforward to connect an agent to an official Glama-hosted MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming the connection flow works smoothly in practice (community evidence only covers quality-score sync issues, not the connect experience).
